rules: as frozen in committed docs/v2.2.md; 180 disjoint calibration observations; no formal-input parameter changes
input_plan: 52 prior development inputs plus12 new generated and4 new real =68; none of the new data used to tune
metrics: per-process P+E+cleanup then median; whole-process wall separate; raw commands/stdout/stderr/resources retained; original automatic SIMD retained
pairing: 10 adjacent randomized AB/BA process pairs for each control, T12/24 primary/critical; candidate20/control10; other conditions5 independent processes
acceptance: primary >=5percent vs original best tested with paired support; <=3percent median vs v2 and same-team pair speedup low95>=0.95; critical v22 vs v2 <=5percent; improve at least2 classes of small/empty/two-giants; old/new T12 negative count vs original no increase relative to v2
scope_limit: R1/R100 large atT24, R9 T1/12/24; original2/4/8 supplemental; not full Cartesian
branch_policy: retain remote optimization/v2.2; if criteria fail switch core checkout back to optimization/v2; no master merge
